fusions.name: Cloak Snap
fusions.desc: A snap of your wing-cloak deals 4 dark damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smothering Drape
fusions.desc: Casts a sheet of dark membrane over the first enemy in its path, dealing 14 dark damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drapery Feint
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds and moves you 2 tiles aside.

fusions.name: Membrane Mantle
fusions.desc: Conjures a cloak of wing-membrane: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.
